conditions.gpu: disabled; software raster and readback included
conditions.workload: Constant-population timings disable knockback in both sources and suppress autonomous specials; subsequent stress checks restore full knockback and specials.

balanceStudy.finding: Shinobi won 45/100 at 25 fighters and 93/100 at 125 fighters. This first configuration does not provide equal class win rates.

limitations: Full-match rates include transitions from Arena to Smash and Duel; they are not isolated per-mode hit probabilities.
Class targeting preferences remain stronger at high populations; distance policy needs a further design decision.
Damage bars describe HP per target at full charge without critical hits or defense; integer rounding applies.
TikTok tests are simulated, with no real LIVE connection.
Software-rendered browser timings are not user-PC or OBS FPS.
